generic.title: Hold this thought
generic.description: Anything you want the Studio to hold — a thought, a line, a fragment. It doesn't need to be finished.
generic.example: e.g. Kept choosing rest today instead of pushing through.

celebration.title: Celebrate something
celebration.prompt: What's one thing that went well?
celebration.description: A win, a small mercy, or something you're grateful for. Naming it lets the Studio remember it with you.
celebration.example: e.g. Finished the hard email — and someone thanked me for it.

possibilities.title: Leave a possibility
possibilities.description: A possibility you want to keep, with no plan attached. It can stay a question.
possibilities.example: e.g. What if we spent a whole winter somewhere warm?

foyer-becoming.title: Name a becoming
foyer-becoming.description: A short sentence about who you're growing into — present tense, as if it is already beginning. It can change any time.
foyer-becoming.example: e.g. I'm becoming someone who rests before they're depleted.

foyer-feeling.title: Make room for a feeling
foyer-feeling.prompt: What feeling would you like to make room for?
foyer-feeling.description: A feeling you want more of in ordinary days. One word or a short phrase is plenty.

foyer-principle.title: Name a guiding principle
foyer-principle.description: A value or principle you want to steer by.
foyer-principle.example: e.g. Depth over breadth — a few things, done with care.
